# When Does an Aesthetic Become a System? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-ppmsca-44953
Voiceover: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — B04-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · INPUT — What enters the aesthetic system?. Inventory references, materials, bodies, techniques, constraints, memories, commissions, budgets, deadlines, collaborators, and cultural knowledge. Attach origin, permission, credit, context, and transformation status to every consequential input.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B04-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · RULE — How does an input change a decision?. Translate a mood into a testable relation: if the material has this weight, the silhouette permits this movement; if the image uses this distance, the body retains this agency. Preserve exceptions and who may authorize them.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B04-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · LOOP — How does the system learn?. Connect sample, fitting, wearer response, production constraint, image review, sales signal, repair evidence, criticism, and archive return. Record which feedback changed the work and which was rejected with reason.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B04-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · RIGHTS — Which outputs or identifiers may be protected?. Map exact works, marks, registrations, contracts, designs, files, and confidential methods separately. Do not convert system documentation into a claim that the overall aesthetic is automatically copyrighted or registrable.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
